scenes.speaker: Library Stairs
lines: Your hands are trembling before the hardest university paper. A senior student passes by:
"You look like you're about to pass out. Take this pill, it kills all panic instantly."

choices.text: "No thanks. I'm going to do 2 minutes of 4-7-8 breathing and drink water. My preparation is enough."
choices.feedback: Outstanding coping mechanism! Deep breathing regulates the vagus nerve safely and immediately.

choices.text: "I'll call my sister to calm my nerves before entering the hall."
choices.feedback: Social grounding through loved ones provides emotional safety without hazardous side effects.

scenes.speaker: Self-Trust
lines: After a few deep breaths, the racing heart slows down. You write the paper with composure and clarity.
Healthy coping mechanisms become permanent inner strengths.
